## Progress

- Merged [PR #687](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/687): Settings -> Staff -> Offboard on a joined (active or suspended) person: reason required (max 500), explicit confirm step. `POST /v1/staff/{membershipId}/offboard` (needs Config on Staff, roles, integrations) sets the membership Offboarded, revokes pending invitations, keeps reason and actor (SettingsChange `staff.offboard`) and audits `staff.offboard` in one serializable transaction, then ends the person's sessions in this tenant only (`RevokeInTenantAsync`). The next request fails (401), the facility picker no longer offers the membership (403), other tenants' sessions stay live; the last active staff administrator is refused (400 `last_admin`, also under concurrency). Mutation-checked (session revoke removed, last-admin check removed: tests fail). EN/HI/AR, RTL, axe clean
- Left: re-activating an offboarded person (new invitation), reassigning or flagging open items (none exist in P1), revoking paired devices (device model is P4), an offboarding report; a never-joined invitee only has the invitation revoked (the membership stays Invited by a check constraint)

## Description

"Offboard" on a staff member sets membership to offboarded, revokes all sessions and devices for that tenant, cancels pending invites, reassigns or flags their open items (none clinical yet in P1), and records reason and actor.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** After offboarding, the next request from any of the person's sessions in that tenant fails within 60 seconds and they cannot sign in to that tenant.
- [ ] **AC2.** Memberships in other tenants are unaffected.
- [ ] **AC3.** The action requires confirmation, a reason, and is audited.
- [ ] **AC4.** The last practice admin cannot offboard themselves (prevents lock-out).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
